description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LocationService in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It tests methods like getLocationById, searchLocations, getSearchLocationListCount, getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation, getLocationIdsForEmployees, and getAccessibleLocationsArray by mocking dependencies and asserting expected behaviors.

classes.name: LocationServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the LocationService class, testing methods like retrieval by ID, search, count, employee location mappings, and accessible locations with mock dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, mocks dependencies, and sets up the LocationService instance.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a Location object by its ID, mocking the DAO response.

methods.name: testSearchLocations
methods.description: Tests the search functionality for locations based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Tests the count of search results for locations.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the number of employees for a specific location.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Tests the mapping of employee numbers to location IDs.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Tests retrieval of accessible locations array, with different parameter scenarios.
